an6.81:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an6.81:1.3: pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesu micchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, pāpiccho ca, micchādiṭṭhī ca.
an6.81:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an6.81:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an6.81:2.3: pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, appiccho ca sammādiṭṭhi ca.
an6.81:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
